messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PAGER-2344 - prod-inference queue backlog high. Queue length: 31,482. Autoscaler controller reports scaling lag for inference-workers. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/inference-queue-backlog

pagerduty-bot: PAGER-2344 assigned to marta (oncall) — please acknowledge

marta: Acked. Oncall here, looking. Can someone paste the autoscaler logs? :eyes:

sam: Logs show repeated failures creating nodes: `error provisioning node: quotaExceeded: Insufficient vCPU quota in us-west1`

```
# controller logs
E 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z autoscaler: failed scale up attempt: provider error: quotaExceeded
E 2026-03-15T09:12:04Z autoscaler: backoff 30s, backlog=31482, desiredNodes=45, availableNodes=28
```

anya: We just deployed a new heavy embedding job around 08:50 which looks correlated. Customer-facing latency rising. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/prod/inference/queue-length

marta: Confirmed increased 5xxs on prod inference, ~11% error rate in the last 10m, mainly queue timeouts. Need short-term relief: manual scale or fallback. @ken can you help with node pool?

ken: On it. I can add nodes manually but quota is the blocker. I can try expand into a different zone if pool has quota. Trying `gcloud compute instances create --zone=us-west1-b ...` now.

ops-automation-bot: Tip: runbook step 3.2 suggests temporary routing to fallback-model for latency sensitive traffic: `traffic-rule set inference-route --fallback-model small-gpt`

marta: Applying fallback for public traffic now to reduce latency. Command:
```
# switch route to fallback
redwoodctl routes update inference --fallback-model small-gpt --apply
```

pagerduty-bot: PAGER-2344 acknowledged by marta. Escalation timer: 5m

sam: FYI autoscaler also logged cloud provider rate limit errors a few minutes ago: `429 TooManyRequests` when calling InstanceTemplates.Create. Might be hitting API quota too.

ken: Manual create returned `Quota 'CPUS' exceeded` in us-west1-b, but us-west1-c has spare cpu quota. Spinning nodes there and will add them to node-pool.

marta: Please post exact commands and done status so I can mark mitigation.

ken: Commands I ran:
```
# create nodes in us-west1-c
gcloud compute instance-templates create inf-node-template-20260315 --machine-type=n2-standard-16 --image=container-vm
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-instance-template inf-node-pool --template=inf-node-template-20260315 --zone=us-west1-c
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize inf-node-pool --size=50 --zone=us-west1-c
```
Output: `Resized managed instance group "inf-node-pool" to 50 instances (was 28)`

ops-automation-bot: Autoscaler noted new capacity, recalculating.

anya: After node addition and route fallback, 5xxs dropped to 1.7% and queue length falling to ~6k. Customers report improvements.

marta: Manual mitigation applied: fallback + additional nodes in us-west1-c. Marking incident partial resolved, still monitoring until queue < 5000 and autoscaler healthy.

sam: Follow-up: autoscaler should treat quotaExceeded differently — currently it keeps retrying with backoff which leaves backlog growing. File a ticket to add a runbook-trigger and a separate alert for provider quota errors.

ken: I filed infra ticket INFRA-789 to request long-term quota increases and to add cross-zone fallback behavior. Also requested emergency quota bump with cloud support (case #CASE-9921).

marta: Closing pager for now — set to resolved in 30m if metrics stable. Creating a post-incident to track root cause and next steps: add alert for `provider_quota_exceeded`, add autoscaler logic to try alternate zones, and add a runbook step to escalate to infra earlier.

anya: Also add a metric to track heavy internal batch jobs that can spike embedding compute, and add a throttle or queue backpressure on batch ingestion.

marta: Thanks team. Oncall handoff note: please include the manual zone expansion commands in the runbook and add who to ping in infra. I'll open the postmortem doc now and assign owners. :white_check_mark: 

pagerduty-bot: PAGER-2344 status changed to RESOLVED by marta
_meta: generated for dataset: slack threads about capacity autoscaler paging and mitigation
